Good! Exit code 143 is SIGTERM (128 + 15 = 143). This means the containers are being killed due to failed liveness probes. The issue is that the liveness probe is failing because it cannot connect to port 8080 at `http://:8080/healthz` after the initial delay of 30 seconds.

Let me search for more information about why an application might not be responding on its health check endpoint.

input.query: health check endpoint port 8080 not responding startup probe initialDelaySeconds
